## Founder

The **founder** of RHINELAB is Bui Gia Khanh. He is also a Principal Investigator (PI) of several groups, as well as **Administrators** handling core logistics and `RHINELAB@LOGISTICS` classification. He is also the author of the **Artifact Archival System** (AAS) that RHINELAB uses, as well as numerous theories that it hosts.
